records.title: Il sistema Ribadier
records.meta: Italian TV theatre film · RAI Secondo Programma, 8 Feb 1974 · Italian · dir. Vittorio Sindoni · 88 min
records.character: Angèle / Angela (Isabella Biagini), second wife of Eugène Ribadier (Antonio Casagrande); widow of M. Robineau
records.mechanism: Literal hypnosis (the 'Ribadier system'): he puts her into a hypnotic sleep and wakes her with a secret cue
records.summary: RAI television version of the 1892 Feydeau–Hennequin farce, made for broadcast. Jealous Angèle, already deceived by her late first husband, watches her second husband closely. Ribadier uses his gift of hypnotism to put her to sleep whenever he leaves for an affair, then wakes her on his return. He unwisely teaches the waking cue to his friend Thommereux (Enrico Montesano), who uses it to confess his love; Angèle later turns the system back on Ribadier. The couple reconcile; no pregnancy or children are mentioned in the cited plot sources.
records.already_married_note: Yes — she is married to Ribadier (her second husband) when he hypnotizes her; she is the widow of M. Robineau
records.pregnancy_note: No pregnancy for Angèle in the cited plot sources (RAI listing, Montesano site, play plot, collection synopsis).
records.kids_note: No children of Angèle’s are mentioned in the cited plot sources (she is introduced as a childless widow of Robineau).
records.kids_together_note: The play and this television version end with a reconciliation; no child of the couple is mentioned.
records.fit_note: Adult married woman hypnotized by her own husband so he can leave the house to have affairs.
records.evidence: RAI Teche broadcast listing (8 Feb 1974, Sindoni, Casagrande/Biagini/Montesano) + Montesano official TV page (made for television) + collection plot that restates the Feydeau system + English Wikipedia play plot.

The system is threatened when Thommereux (Laurent Stocker), in love with Angèle, arrives from Batavia.
